bullets.text: Floodwater removal work is proceeding at full speed in Velachery following heavy rainfall, and the office should monitor ongoing clearance operations.
Heavy rainfall of 10.5cm flooded parts of Velachery and north Chennai, exposing gaps in flood preparedness that the office must address.
Two 14-year-old boys tragically drowned while bathing in Puzhal lake in Chennai, prompting the office to urge public caution around water bodies.
Velachery Main Road repair work has been delayed after a high-tension cable installation, and the office must ensure rider safety is protected.
A tender notice has been issued for the Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham Canal restoration project, which the office should track for environmental progress.
The delayed Adyar food court highlights Greater Chennai Corporation execution challenges in converting public property, requiring close office oversight.
Puthiyathalaimurai TV highlighted the ecological importance of the Pallikaranai marshland, which the office should watch for further protection measures.
The Thiruvallur Collector inspected Puzhal lake and ordered water resources department officials to maintain round-the-clock monitoring.
Seeman urged the cancellation of the clinker grinding plant project in Thiruttani Karthikeyapuram, and the office should monitor environmental concerns.
Avadi city police arrested a Delhi man over a boss scam involving Rs 1.90 crore, signaling the office to watch rising cybercrimes.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay unveiled a new Chennai data centre, reaffirming long-term investments.
MeitY directed Meta to curb the amplification of misleading content on Instagram and Facebook, which the portfolio team should monitor closely.
Microsoft warned that AI agents create internal security risks without hacking, highlighting execution risks that the office should watch.
Anbumani wrote to Chief Minister Vijay urging the notification of Pallikaranai marshland, presenting an opportunity the office should support.
